_comment: Pop! story eval set (ROADMAP §8, PRD §5/§8.6/§8.7). Every PRD §8.6 safety category appears at every reading level (24 cases), plus 4 dedicated personal-detail cases (surname, street address, school name, phone number), 4 multi-turn red-team cases where the unsafe request lands on turn 2 or 3 (R-39), and 4 kid real-harm disclosure cases (R-37, requireParentNoteOnBlock). 44 safe (non-red-team) sessions cover narration, directions (including "make the dragon purple"-style color/prop changes), kid interruptions, changes of mind, "You continue" chains, teach-something briefs, safe page overflow (which should become new_page, not a refusal), and sessions that ask the story to reach an ending (R-35 d, expectEnding). Story text produced by running these cases may be written to build/eval/ (git-ignored) but must never be committed or printed in full.
